summary: Iteration 22: PULIZIE configurator (Spec 1) end-to-end regression. Backend 15/15 pytest PASS covering /pulizie/config, /pulizie/estimate (deterministic pricing + recurrence discount + fee 15%), full IMPRESA lifecycle (create -> admin list w/ compatible[] -> invite -> in_matching -> incoming -> propose -> con_proposte -> confirm charged fee + psp_pending -> start -> complete -> review -> recensita), variation reasons (valid urgenza=80EUR ; invalid reason -> 400 invalid_variation_reason ; decline -> declined:true ; propose without invite -> 403 not_invited), PERSONA_LF flow (voucher rounded to 10EUR multiples, netto = 80% nominale, insufficient borsellino -> 400 lf_insufficient_borsellino, topup -> confirm success, year_total/year_hours updated), provider listino GET/PUT persistence, admin_ui HTML contains 'Pulizie' loader. Frontend 9-step configurator verified in mobile viewport: home->mq->tipo->extra->prod->durata->ricorrenza->flex->details->track->publish flow produced req_f69decc185d1 and navigated to /pulizie/<id> showing 'Richiesta pubblicata!' + 'In attesa di proposte...' as spec'd. Listino screen (/pulizie/listino for req-prov-token) renders with f-tariffa_ordinaria/save-listino and pre-filled €13/€16/€19 rates. Client richieste tab correctly merges pulizie rows w/ Italian status pills (Pubblicata, In matching, Con proposte, Confermata, Recensita). One real integration bug found: provider 'Richieste in arrivo' incoming section is NOT rendered for BUSINESS-role users because /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/richieste.tsx:12 gates on `user?.role === 'provider'` only, but req-prov-token seeded user is role='business' (backend /api/pulizie/incoming already allows both roles). One backend semantics quirk in confirm(): the LF branch sets pagamento_lavoro = {'stato':'lf', **lf}, but lf dict also contains 'stato':'coperto' -> dict-spread overrides -> final stato is 'coperto' not 'lf' (still functionally OK because nominale/voucher/netto_lavoratrice are stored). Otherwise deterministic pricing matches spec exactly (13*3 + 5 supp + 10 forno = 54; 15% fee = 8.10 => 62.10). Deprecated shadow* style warning still recurring (see react_native_issues).

minor.issue: pagamento_lavoro final 'stato' is 'coperto' instead of 'lf' because `{'stato':'lf', **lf}` is spread AFTER lf's own stato='coperto' key -> spread overrides. Reference: /app/backend/routers/richieste.py:326-332. Either rename lf dict key to avoid collision or reverse spread order: `{**lf, 'stato':'lf'}`. Not blocking (nominale/voucher/netto_lavoratrice persist correctly).

ui_bugs.issue: Provider incoming Pulizie section (`incoming-<id>` testIDs) is only rendered when user.role === 'provider'. Business-role users (e.g. req-prov-token seed) never see it, even though backend /api/pulizie/incoming allows business role and returns 6 pending invites. Fix: `user?.role === 'provider' || user?.role === 'business' ? <ProviderJobs /> : <CustomerRequests />`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/richieste.tsx:12.

integration_issues.flow: Business provider (impresa) cannot see incoming Pulizie invitations in Richieste tab despite backend serving them via /api/pulizie/incoming.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Recurs on /pulizie/configura, /pulizie/[id], /pulizie/listino, /richieste. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Migrate to `boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)'` (react-native-web supports it) or Platform.select() split.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/richieste.tsx:12 — include 'business' role in ProviderJobs gate so impresa providers see 'Richieste in arrivo' section with `incoming-<id>` testIDs (backend already supports it).
FIX (minor): /app/backend/routers/richieste.py:326-332 — reorder spread to `{**lf, 'stato':'lf'}` (or rename inner 'stato' key) so pagamento_lavoro.stato for LF is 'lf' not 'coperto'.
(minor) Migrate shadow* props to boxShadow to silence recurring deprecation warnings across the Pulizie screens.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/richieste.py deterministic price engine is well-structured: compute_work_total() applies tariffa*ore + prodotti supplement + extras + stiro + ricorrenza discount, then price_breakdown() adds fee%; matches spec.
compatible_providers() correctly filters by role/services/binario/pulizie_listino + haversine distance vs listino.raggio_km + prodotti_propri check + minimo_ore. ✓
State machine is enforced consistently: STATES_OPEN gate on propose(), 'no_proposals' check on confirm(), 'not_confirmed' on start(), 'not_in_progress' on complete(), 'not_completed' on review(). ✓
get_richiesta() correctly hides exact indirizzo for non-owner (until confirmed). ✓
admin_invite() is idempotent (skips already-invited providers) and only transitions to in_matching when new invites happen. ✓

lf_topup input validates amount>0. LF year totals are $inc'd on confirm — good, but there is no server-side ceiling enforcement (LF_YEAR_CEILING_EUR=2500) beyond the 'alert' flag; consider a hard cap.
9-step configurator (configura.tsx) has full testID coverage on every option and next/publish buttons. ✓
Client richieste tab merges richieste w/ correct StatusPill mapping for all 9 pulizie statuses (pubblicata/in_matching/con_proposte/confermata/in_corso/completata/recensita/scaduta/annullata). ✓
listino.tsx exposes f-<key> testIDs for every tariff & extra + save-listino; GET/PUT round-trips through the same shape. ✓

rca_of_issue: Frontend role-gate: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/richieste.tsx line 12 uses strict equality `user?.role === 'provider'` to decide between ProviderJobs and CustomerRequests. Backend seeds impresa listino on both 'provider' and 'business' users (server.py line 82-96 iterates all users with services='pulizie'), and /api/pulizie/incoming allows role in ('provider','business'). Business-role providers therefore correctly RECEIVE invitations from admin, but the frontend never renders the ProviderJobs view for them so the 'Richieste in arrivo' section is invisible. Reproduction: inject req-prov-token, open /richieste — you see the CustomerRequests empty/mixed view. Curl `/api/pulizie/incoming` with the same token returns 6 open invites. Mitigation: widen the gate to `['provider','business'].includes(user?.role)`. Similar patterns likely elsewhere (profile-listino access) — worth grepping for `role === 'provider'`.
